securityAlert.title: Permissions & Security Policy
securityAlert.body: All LLM calls are routed exclusively through grafana-llm-app (whether using air-gapped local vLLM or internet-hosted OpenAI / OpenAI-compatible APIs, configure the endpoint URL, API key, and model mappings in grafana-llm-app). The service account token entered below is stored encrypted in secureJsonData and is never reused for datasource queries or dashboard writes.

status.savedMessage: Settings saved. Reload the page to apply changes.

validation.allowMockRequired: Explicitly enable allowMockInDev to save llmMode=mock.
validation.numberRange: {{label}} must be a number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
validation.reasoningEffort: Reasoning Effort must be blank or one of: low, medium, high.
validation.redisAddrRequired: Redis address must be a valid host:port (or [ipv6]:port) without URL scheme, whitespace, or embedded credentials when jobStoreBackend=redis.
validation.redisKeyPrefixInvalid: Redis key prefix must be 1..64 characters of [a-zA-Z0-9:_-].
validation.redisUsernameTooLong: Redis ACL username must be 128 UTF-8 bytes or fewer.
validation.postgresAddrRequired: PostgreSQL address must be a valid host:port (or [ipv6]:port) without URL scheme, whitespace, or embedded credentials when jobStoreBackend=postgres.
validation.postgresDatabaseRequired: PostgreSQL database name is required (1..63 UTF-8 bytes without whitespace, control characters, or BOM) when jobStoreBackend=postgres.
validation.postgresUsernameRequired: PostgreSQL username is required (1..128 UTF-8 bytes without control characters or BOM) when jobStoreBackend=postgres.
validation.postgresSchemaInvalid: PostgreSQL schema must be 1..63 lowercase characters matching [a-z_][a-z0-9_]* and must not be a reserved system schema (pg_*, information_schema).
validation.postgresTablePrefixInvalid: PostgreSQL table prefix must be 1..32 lowercase characters matching [a-z_][a-z0-9_]*.
validation.postgresSslModeInvalid: PostgreSQL SSL mode must be one of: disable, prefer, require, verify-ca, verify-full.

datasource.allowedUidsDescription: Only datasources listed here can be selected in Studio. The LLM can never specify arbitrary datasource UIDs.
datasource.dialectsDescription: Pin a datasource UID to MetricsQL (e.g., VictoriaMetrics connected via Grafana's built-in Prometheus datasource) or PromQL. Leave Auto to infer from the datasource plugin type.

llm.modeGrafanaLlmApp: grafana-llm-app (Recommended for production — relays local vLLM / OpenAI-compatible APIs)
llm.allowMockLabel: Explicitly allow mock mode for development & testing
llm.allowMockDescription: Keep disabled in production. Real LLM failures never fall back to mock mode automatically.
llm.grafanaUrlDescription: URL used by the Go backend llmclient to connect to /api/plugins/grafana-llm-app/resources/llm/v1 (loopback or same origin as Grafana AppURL only).
llm.structuredOutputDescription: Recommended: json_schema for OpenAI (GPT-4o/4.1/5), Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, Gemini OpenAI-compatible, and vLLM. Choose json_object for OpenAI-compatible APIs without json_schema support (e.g., DeepSeek API).
llm.structuredOutputSchema: json_schema (Standard — recommended for OpenAI / OpenRouter / Gemini-compat / vLLM)
llm.structuredOutputObject: json_object (For OpenAI-compatible APIs without json_schema support)
llm.tokenLimitDescription: Use max_completion_tokens for OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, and vLLM. Choose max_tokens for legacy or third-party OpenAI-compatible APIs (e.g., DeepSeek API).
llm.reasoningEffortDescription: Leave unspecified (auto) for standard models (GPT-4o / GPT-4.1 / Llama / DeepSeek-Chat, etc.). For reasoning models (o3 / GPT-5 / GLM-5.3, etc.), "low" is recommended to curb excessive thinking time.
llm.reasoningEffortAuto: Unspecified / Auto (Recommended for standard OpenAI & OpenAI-compatible models)
llm.saTokenDescription: Assign the minimum basic role Viewer in Grafana OSS and dedicate it solely to llmclient (reset and save blank to delete an existing token).

limits.fieldset: Budgets & Query Limits (Initial Defaults — Tune for Your Environment)

jobStorage.backendDescription: Use memory (zero dependencies) for single-instance Grafana, or redis / postgres for persistent multi-replica HA deployments.
jobStorage.redisAddrDescription: Single-endpoint host:port or [ipv6]:port of your Redis/Valkey server or cluster proxy (e.g., redis:6379). Never embed passwords in the address.
jobStorage.redisKeyPrefixDescription: Namespace prefix wrapped in a hash tag ({prefix}); use redisDb=0 when connecting through a Redis Cluster proxy.
jobStorage.redisPasswordDescription: Stored encrypted in secureJsonData and never returned to the browser (reset and save blank to clear).
jobStorage.redisTlsCheckbox: Use TLS (minimum TLS 1.2, system root CA trust store)
jobStorage.postgresAddrDescription: Single-endpoint host:port or [ipv6]:port of your PostgreSQL server (e.g., postgres:5432). Connect directly or via session pooling (PgBouncer transaction pooling breaks LISTEN/NOTIFY). Never embed passwords in the address.
jobStorage.postgresDatabaseDescription: Target database name (e.g., grafana or a dedicated database for plugin job state).
jobStorage.postgresSchemaDescription: Lowercase schema where job tables are created (default: public). On PostgreSQL 15+ or when sharing Grafana's database, pre-create a dedicated schema (e.g., llm_studio) or pre-create tables for a DML-only role.
jobStorage.postgresTablePrefixDescription: Lowercase prefix for plugin-owned tables (default: llm_studio_, creating llm_studio_jobs and llm_studio_slots).
jobStorage.postgresPasswordDescription: Stored encrypted in secureJsonData and never returned to the browser (reset and save blank to clear).
jobStorage.postgresSslModeDescription: TLS transport mode for PostgreSQL connections (minimum TLS 1.2). verify-ca and verify-full validate certificates against the container/host system root CA trust store; use require, verify-ca, or verify-full in production.
jobStorage.postgresSslModePrefer: prefer (Default — TLS if supported, fallback to plaintext)
jobStorage.postgresSslModeVerifyCa: verify-ca (Require TLS 1.2+ and verify CA certificate)
jobStorage.postgresSslModeVerifyFull: verify-full (Require TLS 1.2+, verify CA and hostname)
